name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital micro-credit starting at ₹10,000, scaling to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000, with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions.
who_can_apply_intro: All eligible citizens who meet the PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) guidelines.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_steps: Check that your Aadhaar card and active bank passbook are ready.
Visit the official portal or your local Common Service Centre (CSC) / Panchayat office.
Fill in the application details and complete your biometric or OTP e-KYC.
Receive your application reference number to track verification and direct payment status.
